children: Shares of CPI Card Group were down after the company priced a registered underwritten secondary public offering of 2.3 million shares to be sold by certain stockholders affiliated with Parallel49 Equity, at a public offering price of $21.50 a share.
The stock was 15% lower, at $22.79, but is still 50% higher in the past 12 months.

The payment technology company said the underwriters were granted a 30-day option to buy up to an additional 350,600 shares from the selling stockholders at the public offering price, less the underwriting discount.
The offering is expected to close on or about Monday.

CPI Card Group isn't offering any shares in the offering, and won't receive any proceeds from the sale by the selling stockholders. Total proceeds from the offering to the selling stockholders are expected to be $50.3 million.
